extracted.intended_audience: researchers (all career stages, with special emphasis on early-career and historically excluded communities)
extracted.subtask_description: Platform and community resources for writing, requesting, and receiving open reviews of preprints and datasets, plus training, live collaborative review sessions, and community clubs to build reviewing skills and provide timely feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Openness and accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Open preprint reviews. For all researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide and receive constructive feedback on preprints from an international community of your peers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constructive feedback
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site emphasizes providing constructive feedback on preprints and datasets (phrased repeatedly as 'Provide and receive constructive feedback').

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness of review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PREreview Clubs: 'Start or join one of our preprint review groups, where members work together to provide timely, constructive feedback.' Live Reviews are also offered as an alternative to traditional peer review to accelerate feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer reviewer training and skill development
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer review training — Interactive workshops for organizations and institutions looking to help their members hone their skills as reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site offers interactive workshops and training resources to help reviewers improve their skills ('Peer review training', 'Interactive workshops... to help their members hone their skills as reviewers').

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative and interactive review formats (Live Reviews)
rubrics_metrics.description: Live Reviews — collaborative, interactive preprint review calls as an alternative approach to traditional peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Live Reviews are run as collaborative, interactive calls to review preprints collectively and provide an alternative to one-on-one traditional peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community-based review groups (PREreview Clubs)
rubrics_metrics.description: PREreview Clubs — start or join a preprint review group where members work together to review preprints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clubs are positioned for members to collaborate and provide feedback together; the site lists many PREreview clubs and encourages joining or starting them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dataset review capability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The platform supports reviewing datasets in addition to preprints ('Review a dataset').

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusivity and support for underserved researchers
rubrics_metrics.description: We support and empower diverse and historically excluded communities of researchers (particularly those at early stages of their career) to find a voice, train, and engage in peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organisation explicitly targets support for underserved researchers—training, empowerment, and engagement to increase participation in peer review ('For underserved researchers, there’s a better way').

rubrics_metrics.name: Review request mechanism (author-initiated reviews)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors can publish requests for reviews (the site displays recent review requests and their preprint servers), enabling community members to respond to solicitations for feedback.
